'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Jon Benkert Holtet LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jon Benkert Holtet]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Jon Benkert Holtet]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
